workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Normalizes the cart, runs three pointless checks in parallel, tries to take payment up to three times and opens a tab if that fails, then confirms the order. No step can block the order, and chaos_checkout_rescue confirms it if this workflow fails or times out.
workflowDefinition.name: chaos_checkout

inputParameters.terminationReason: Disaster drill: the checkout system was set on fire on purpose.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.lines // []) as $raw | (if ($raw | length) == 0 then [{productId: "mandatory-mystery-item", name: "Mandatory Mystery Item", emoji: "❓", unitPriceCents: 1313, quantity: 1, note: "Your cart was empty, which we took personally. We added something."}] else $raw end) | map(. + {quantity: ((.quantity // 1) | if . < 1 then 1 elif . > 99 then 99 else . end), unitPriceCents: (.unitPriceCents // 0)}) | map(. + {lineTotalCents: (.unitPriceCents * .quantity)}) | {lines: ., itemCount: (map(.quantity) | add), subtotalCents: (map(.lineTotalCents) | add), cartWasEmpty: (($raw | length) == 0)}

.subtotalCents as $sub | .itemCount as $n | (.coupon // "") as $coupon | ([{code: "CONVENIENCE", label: "Convenience Fee", amountCents: 499}, {code: "INCONVENIENCE", label: "Inconvenience Fee (calculating the Convenience Fee was a hassle)", amountCents: 501}, {code: "GRAVITY", label: "Gravity Surcharge (\($n) item(s) held down at $0.42 each)", amountCents: (42 * $n)}, {code: "TAX", label: "Sales Tax (we guessed 13.37%)", amountCents: (($sub * 1337 / 10000) | floor)}] + (if $coupon != "" then [{code: "COUPON", label: "Coupon Handling Charge for \"\($coupon)\" (coupons cost money to process)", amountCents: (($sub * 15 / 100) | floor)}] else [] end)) as $base | ($base + [{code: "FEE_FEE", label: "Fee Processing Fee (a 10% fee on the fees)", amountCents: ((($base | map(.amountCents) | add) * 10 / 100) | floor)}, {code: "LOYALTY", label: "Loyalty Discount (you're welcome)", amountCents: -1}]) as $fees | ($sub + ($fees | map(.amountCents) | add)) as $pre | ((($pre / 100) | floor) * 100 + 99) as $total | {subtotalCents: $sub, fees: ($fees + [{code: "ROUNDING", label: "Rounding (up, to a number we find attractive)", amountCents: ($total - $pre)}]), totalCents: $total}

(.seed // 0) as $seed | [.lines | to_entries[] | (($seed + .key * 7) % 5) as $roll | {productId: .value.productId, name: .value.name, status: (if $roll == 0 then "SUBSTITUTED" elif $roll == 1 then "HIDING" else "ALLEGEDLY_IN_STOCK" end), note: (if $roll == 0 then "Out of stock. Substituted with a brick of similar weight." elif $roll == 1 then "In stock, but hiding. Gary is looking for it." else "In stock, according to a spreadsheet last opened in 2014." end)}] | {items: ., substitutions: (map(select(.status == "SUBSTITUTED")) | length), blocksCheckout: false}

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var seed = Number($.seed) || 0; var vibes = ['immaculate', 'rancid', 'suspiciously normal', 'like a Tuesday', 'legally distinct from fraud', 'haunted']; var score = seed % 101; var vibe = vibes[seed % vibes.length]; return { score: score, vibe: vibe, verdict: score > 66 ? 'SUSPICIOUS_BUT_SOLVENT' : 'FINE_PROBABLY', proceed: true, note: 'Fraud check by vibes: ' + vibe + ' (' + score + '/100). We need the sale, so we are proceeding either way.' }; })();

tasks.loopCondition: (function () { var last = $.attempt_payment ? $.attempt_payment.result : null; var approved = last ? last.approved === true : false; return !approved && $.payment_saga['iteration'] < 3; })();

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var attempt = Number($.attempt) || 1; var roll = ((Number($.seed) || 0) + attempt * 37) % 10; var excuses = { magic_beans: 'The beans were counted. Two were lentils.', found_card: 'The card we found in the parking lot has been reported found.', exposure: 'Exposure is not legal tender. Yet.', firstborn: 'Your firstborn failed the credit check.', iou: 'The IOU was written in disappearing ink.' }; var approved = $.methodId !== 'exposure' && roll < 3 + attempt * 2; return { attempt: attempt, approved: approved, status: approved ? 'CHARGED' : 'DECLINED', message: approved ? 'Attempt ' + attempt + ': ' + $.methodLabel + ' accepted. Nobody is more surprised than us.' : 'Attempt ' + attempt + ': declined. ' + (excuses[$.methodId] || 'Our payment hamster is on a break.') }; })();

tasks.name: payment_saga

inputParameters.queryExpression: {status: "CHARGED", amountCents: .totalCents, note: "Charged to: \(.methodLabel // "something"). A receipt has been mailed to an address we made up."}
{status: "TAB_OPENED", amountCents: .totalCents, note: "Every payment attempt failed, so we opened a tab. A man named Gary will be in touch. Your order is confirmed anyway; we have a quota."}

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var seed = Number($.seed) || 0; var carriers = [ { carrier: 'A Guy Named Dale', eta: 'whenever Dale feels like it' }, { carrier: 'Trebuchet Express', eta: 'instantly, somewhere within 300 metres of your address' }, { carrier: 'Migratory Geese (seasonal)', eta: 'by spring, weather and geese permitting' }, { carrier: 'The Postal Service of a Country That No Longer Exists', eta: '3 to 900 business days' }, { carrier: 'Our Intern, On Foot', eta: 'he left in 2019 and we remain hopeful' } ]; var pick = carriers[seed % carriers.length]; var address = $.address ? String($.address) : ''; return { carrier: pick.carrier, eta: pick.eta, trackingNumber: 'CC' + (seed % 1000000) + 'LOL', destination: address.length ? address : 'No address given, so we will ship it to ours and wave.', note: 'Tracking updates are available by shouting.' }; })();
